# Roots the effect preview sweeps: one path substring per line, `#` comments
# allowed. `PWE_PREVIEW_ROOTS` on the command line or a `workflow_dispatch`
# input overrides this file; nothing here changes how a root is drawn.
#
# The sweep is one entry per mechanism, not every root: the aquarium holds the
# model elements (160) whose keypoint scale this pass fixed, and the rest are the
# placements earlier reports named — the seal dome that drew at 3.3x, the crystal
# at 2.7x, the floating city's misplacement, the two-unit mushrooms, the sea
# dust, the waterfalls and the six disputed roots of §57.9.
#
# `PWE_PREVIEW_PER_ROOT` is 1 and the run stops at `PWE_PREVIEW_MAX`, so a list
# long enough to be truncated skips whichever placements the map stores last.
